lines.note: The expressive word ‘короктоп’ is read as swaggering; its precise shade of movement is uncertain.

lines.english: Taking a force of some seven hundred,

lines.note: The garment term ‘күрмөчө’ and the expressive description are read as a short coat bulging out.

lines.english: His coat of mail spreading broad,
The army marching in a rumbling throng,
What the soldiers bore slung upon them:

lines.note: ‘Алеңгир’ is provisionally read as an epithet meaning mighty; the exact kind or quality of bow is uncertain.
‘Аңгеме,’ literally a story or matter, is read here as trouble brought upon Jakyp.
